Checkout metadata (payg_accrual_id + target_categories) drives the webhook + DB-trigger settlement chain that flips the invoice to paid
Rationale: sum ledger remaining_amount, not gross accruals — an accrual stays 'open' until every category drains, so gross summing re-bills already-paid rent

only_rental_id sandbox scoping — a Time Machine dispatch can never touch another tenant's rentals

Rationale: forked renderer without the plate-privacy guard — vehicle_reg blanked at composition because nothing downstream would catch it
